name: Dilated Cardiomyopathy-Hypergonadotropic Hypogonadism Syndrome

criteria.description: Echocardiographic evidence of dilated cardiomyopathy with left ventricular dilation and systolic dysfunction
Laboratory confirmation of hypergonadotropic hypogonadism characterized by elevated gonadotropins (LH, FSH) and low sex steroid levels
Exclusion of secondary causes of cardiomyopathy and hypogonadism such as ischemic, infectious, or toxic etiologies
Positive family history of cardiomyopathy or hypogonadism

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of echocardiographic evidence of dilated cardiomyopathy plus laboratory-confirmed hypergonadotropic hypogonadism with exclusion of secondary causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may support diagnosis but is not mandatory

pathognomonic.symptomName: Aplasia of the phalanges of the 3rd toe

laboratory: Elevated serum luteinizing hormone (LH) and follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH)
Low serum testosterone or estradiol levels
Elevated B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP) or NT-proBNP indicating heart failure
imaging: Echocardiogram showing dilated left ventricle with reduced ejection fraction
Cardiac MRI may show myocardial fibrosis and dilation
other: Testicular ultrasound showing reduced testicular volume
Electrocardiogram abnormalities including arrhythmias or conduction defects

distinguishingFeatures: Characteristic tall stature and cognitive features
Normal or elevated testosterone with end-organ resistance
Female external genitalia despite XY karyotype

redFlags: Rapid progression of heart failure symptoms
Marked testicular atrophy with delayed puberty
references: Orphanet: Dilated cardiomyopathy-hypergonadotropic hypogonadism syndrome - ORPHA:2229
Maron BJ, Towbin JA, Thiene G, et al. Contemporary definitions and classification of the cardiomyopathies: an American Heart Association Scientific Statement. Circulation. 2006;113(14):1807-1816.
Nieschlag E, Behre HM, Nieschlag S. Testosterone: Action, Deficiency, Substitution. Cambridge University Press; 2012.
